// Pinned PASS fixture for scripts/verify_hollow_tests.py (SPEC-056).
// Every it()/test() block carries an expect assertion.
// Stored with a .txt suffix so repo tooling (autotest hook, JS runners)
// never treats it as a runnable test; tests rename it to sample.test.ts
// inside tmp_path before invoking the validator.
import { describe, it, expect, test } from "vitest";

function sum(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a + b;
}

describe("sum", () => {
  it("adds two numbers", () => {
    expect(sum(1, 2)).toEqual(3);
  });

  test("handles zero", () => {
    expect(sum(0, 0)).toBe(0);
  });
});
